Zoya Desai | zoya.desai676@example.com | +91 9481017125
Chennai
Data scientist focused on building production ML systems, model lifecycle management and healthcare analytics. Notice period: 60 days.

Senior Data Scientist, Zoho — Feb 2024 - Jul 2026
Led development and productionization of customer churn and product recommendation models for B2B SaaS modules. Implemented end-to-end pipelines using MLflow to track experiments and deployments; reduced model deployment time by 40% through standardized MLflow workflows. Built ensemble and stacked models with scikit-learn for cross-product recommendations, improving precision@10 by 18%. Collaborated with engineering on CI/CD and deployed models on Linux-based MLOps infrastructure; coordinated feature parity and releases via Jira and Confluence.

Data Scientist, Medisure — Apr 2023 - Jan 2024
Designed predictive models for readmission risk and claim fraud scoring using scikit-learn and PyTorch for hybrid models; achieved a 22% lift in early-risk detection. Managed experiment tracking and model versioning with MLflow and automated evaluation pipelines in Python. Worked with clinical teams to translate model outputs into actionable rules tracked in Jira and documented in Confluence.

Data Scientist, Orbit Health — Dec 2020 - Mar 2023
Developed patient risk stratification and outcome prediction models using Python and scikit-learn; improved cohort targeting accuracy by 15%. Built feature stores and SQL queries to aggregate longitudinal patient data for training. Collaborated with clinicians to validate model assumptions; integrated models into care workflows running on Linux servers. Emphasized reproducibility and monitoring for deployed models.

Machine Learning Engineer, Covalent Infotech — Jun 2017 - Nov 2020
Implemented NLP pipelines for resume parsing and customer support ticket classification using Natural Language Processing techniques and scikit-learn; increased extraction accuracy by 30%. Designed ETL and feature engineering processes using SQL and Python to prepare large text datasets. Maintained model documentation and tracked development tasks in Jira and Confluence.

Skills: Python; Machine Learning; scikit-learn; SQL; PyTorch; Natural Language Processing; MLflow; Jira; Confluence; Linux

Education: MBA (Finance), NMIMS
